name: Canned food
purpose_line: 4 rations of food
almanac_text: Four meals in a tin. The label promises flavour; the can promises nothing.

name: Water
purpose_line: 4 rations of water
almanac_text: Four days of not dying of thirst, if you share it the way the label suggests.

name: Axe
purpose_line: Stops one raid or indoor threat; then it breaks
almanac_text: Opens doors, fridges and arguments. Usually only once.

name: Rifle
purpose_line: Stops raids; each use costs 1 ammo
almanac_text: Settles disputes. Without ammo it is a very persuasive stick, half the time.

name: Ammo
purpose_line: Feeds the rifle; trades for about 1 water
almanac_text: A box of reasons the rifle still works.

name: Padlock
purpose_line: Stops one raid; locks the hatch when everyone is out
almanac_text: Holds the hatch shut once. After that it is jewellery.

name: Bug spray
purpose_line: Kills indoor pests; used up
almanac_text: Smells like a summer evening. The bugs disagree.

name: Survival manual
purpose_line: Repairs gear (85%); study it to learn crafting
almanac_text: Three hundred pages of advice written by someone with a garage.

name: Medkit
purpose_line: Cures one sick or injured person
almanac_text: Gauze, antiseptic, and the confidence of a professional.

name: Suitcase
purpose_line: +3 carry slots on expeditions
almanac_text: Wheels, a handle, and room for three more reasons to come home.

name: Radio
purpose_line: Hears rescue broadcasts and the all-clear
almanac_text: Hand-cranked. Mostly static, occasionally hope, once a mattress commercial.

name: Gas mask
purpose_line: Trips in heavy fallout: sick 20% instead of 70%
almanac_text: Keeps fallout dust out of the lungs and conversation to a minimum.

name: Flashlight
purpose_line: Signals rescue; saves you in dark events
almanac_text: Two batteries of courage.

name: Map
purpose_line: Trips 1 day shorter and safer; needed for meet-ups
almanac_text: A paper map. It does not need a signal or an update.

name: Cards
purpose_line: Restores morale; a gift or trade good
almanac_text: Fifty-two cards and one rulebook nobody agrees on.

name: Game console
purpose_line: Restores morale; helps the kids sleep
almanac_text: Battery at 61%. Somebody's save file is at stake.

name: Toaster
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Metal, 1 Electronics
almanac_text: It will never toast again, but the wiring inside is still good.

name: Pots & pans
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Metal
almanac_text: Nested, heavy, and loud on the ladder. Mostly useful as metal.

name: Old phone
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Electronics
almanac_text: The screen is cracked and two software updates are waiting. The circuit board still works.

name: Smart speaker
purpose_line: Breaks into 1 Electronics, 1 Plastic
almanac_text: It used to tell you the weather. It has nothing to say about this weather.

name: Bedsheet
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Cloth
almanac_text: Thread count unknown. It tears into good long strips.

name: Umbrella
purpose_line: Breaks into 1 Metal, 1 Cloth
almanac_text: Rated for drizzle. Its ribs make good wire.

name: Bag of bottles
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Plastic
almanac_text: Saved for the recycling, which is not coming.

name: Cleaning spray
purpose_line: Breaks into 1 Chemicals, 1 Plastic
almanac_text: Kills 99.9% of household germs, says the label. The other 0.1% are welcome to the shelter.

name: Hand sanitizer
purpose_line: Breaks into 1 Chemicals
almanac_text: Seventy percent alcohol, thirty percent gel.

name: Duct tape
purpose_line: Breaks into 2 Binding
almanac_text: Holds most of a house together if you ask it to.

name: Extension cord
purpose_line: Breaks into 1 Electronics, 1 Binding
almanac_text: Ten metres of copper and an orange jacket.

name: Rag bandage
purpose_line: Makeshift medkit: cures Injured only
almanac_text: Torn sheet boiled in sanitizer. It closes a wound; it does nothing for a fever.

name: Bedsheet bindle
purpose_line: Makeshift suitcase: +2 carry for 2 trips
almanac_text: A sheet, a knot and a pole. It carries two more things home before the knot gives.

name: Bottle filter
purpose_line: Makeshift purifier: dirty water becomes water, 3 jugs
almanac_text: Sand, cloth and a cut bottle. The water comes out slowly and tastes like the inside of a bottle.

name: Rag respirator
purpose_line: Makeshift gas mask: halves the fallout sickness risk for 2 trips
almanac_text: Three layers of cloth and a strip of tape. Better than breathing the street.

name: Door barricade
purpose_line: Makeshift padlock: stops one raid 60% of the time, then breaks
almanac_text: Pans, pipe and tape wedged under the hatch. It holds once, if it holds at all.

name: Tin-can alarm
purpose_line: Wakes the shelter when a thief comes at night; works twice
almanac_text: Cans on a string across the ladder. The oldest burglar alarm there is.

name: Pipe club
purpose_line: Makeshift axe for raid nights: stops a raid 50% of the time; may break
almanac_text: A length of pipe with a taped grip. It ends arguments about half the time.

name: Phone torch
purpose_line: Makeshift flashlight for dark moments, 2 uses; can't signal a rescue
almanac_text: Two dead phones and a battery that wasn't. Enough light to see your hands.

name: Scrap receiver
purpose_line: Makeshift radio: hears broadcasts on half the days; can't transmit
almanac_text: It hears the news through the hiss about half the time. Nobody can hear you on it.

name: Soap spray
purpose_line: Makeshift bug spray: works 65% of the time, once
almanac_text: Soap, alcohol and water in a sprayer. The ants are not impressed by everything.

name: Sock puppet show
purpose_line: Makeshift console: +1 morale for everyone, once
almanac_text: Two socks, buttons for eyes and a plot nobody rehearsed. It works exactly once.
